The bug is on line 9. The loop range uses `len(values) - window` which excludes the last valid window position. It should be `len(values) - window + 1`.
The bug was an off-by-one error in `stats_utils.py:9`. The loop used `range(len(values) - window)` which excluded the last valid window position. For a list of length 5 with window 3, it computed windows starting at indices 0 and 1 but missed index 2 (the last valid start position).

Fixed to `range(len(values) - window + 1)` so all valid window positions are included.
